sources.entry: Paste Quick - A simple, privacy-first clipboard manager. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/app/paste-quick/6723903021?platform=mac)

summary.name: PasteQuick
summary.one_liner: PasteQuick is a privacy-focused macOS clipboard manager that keeps a searchable history of copied or cut text, links, images, and code.
use_cases: Find and reuse previously copied text, links, images, or code
Keep clipboard history private on a Mac
Let AI assistants read or summarize clipboard content
Preview copied images without opening them
Build AI-powered workflows from clipboard data
summary.what_it_does: PasteQuick records everything copied or cut and saves it to a history list so past clipboard items can be found and reused. All clipboard history is stored locally on the device, and specific applications can be excluded from recording. It shows image thumbnail previews and offers customizable list display options to show or hide content. It also runs as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, letting AI assistants such as Grok, Claude Desktop, or Cursor access clipboard content, with example commands and config for adding it.
notable: Stores all clipboard history locally with per-app exclusion
Built-in MCP server lets AI assistants access the clipboard
Image thumbnail previews in history list
Listed on the App Store and in awesome-mac
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
